about: Hand labels for search results: is this center a real fit for the search (in the country, runs the campaign)? fit = evidence clearly shows it; partial = plausible but the evidence is weak or ties the campaign to the center only loosely; not_fit = wrong company, wrong country or not an insurance campaign. Labelled from the stored evidence quotes on 2026-10-26. 'tuning' labels were used while changing the scoring; 'held_out' labels come from four later searches the scoring was not tuned on.
